expect.label: Together AI
expect.description: Open models, pay per token (prepaid, 5 USD minimum).

billing.note: Prepaid; a 5 USD credit purchase is required before any use. No free models.

expect.label: Fireworks AI
expect.description: Fast serverless open models.

billing.note: Prepaid credits, no free models. 10 requests a minute until a payment method is added.

expect.label: DeepInfra
expect.description: Low-cost open model hosting.

billing.note: Needs a card or prepaid balance before any use; no free models.

expect.label: Novita AI
expect.description: Open model hosting.

billing.note: Credit balance with optional auto top-up; no free models.

expect.label: Hyperbolic
expect.description: Open model hosting.

billing.note: Prepaid balance; requests are refused at zero. Verifying a phone adds a one-time 1 USD credit.

expect.label: Nebius Token Factory
expect.description: European open model hosting.

billing.note: Pay per token; no free models.

expect.label: Requesty
expect.description: LLM router with many upstreams; a few models are free (200 requests a day).

billing.note: Free models: 200 requests a day, no card. Other models are billed at provider price plus 5%.

expect.label: Cerebras
expect.description: Wafer-scale inference, very high tokens per second.

billing.note: No permanent free tier: a 5 USD trial credit (verified payment method required, expires after 30 days), then prepaid credits.

expect.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
expect.description: Serverless models on Cloudflare with a daily free allowance.

billing.note: Free only on the Workers Free plan: 10,000 neurons a day, then requests fail. Some models (Kimi K2.6/K2.7, GLM-5.2/5.3, DeepSeek V4) need Workers Paid and are never free. On Workers Paid the overage is billed: choose paid for such accounts.

expect.label: Cohere
expect.description: Command models via the OpenAI compatibility API.

billing.note: Trial keys are free: 1,000 API calls a month and 20 chat requests a minute; requests fail beyond that. Production keys are billed per token.

expect.label: Deepgram
expect.description: Nova speech-to-text and Aura voices.

billing.note: New projects get a one-time 200 USD credit (no card needed, does not expire); after that, usage is billed per minute and per character.

expect.label: ElevenLabs
expect.description: Natural voices and Scribe speech-to-text.

billing.note: Free plan: 10,000 credits a month, non-commercial with attribution, default voices only (library voices need a paid plan). Requests fail beyond it unless a pay-as-you-go balance was topped up, which is then spent: choose paid for paid-plan keys or accounts with a top-up balance.

expect.label: Google Gemini
expect.description: Gemini and Gemma models through the Gemini API (AI Studio).

billing.note: Free only while the Google Cloud project behind the key has no billing account; with billing enabled every request is charged. NeoRouter verifies this automatically and only treats models with a free tier as free.

expect.label: Groq
expect.description: LPU inference with a generous free tier for open models.

billing.note: Free while the Groq organisation is on the Free plan (no payment method). NeoRouter checks the plan limits on every response and stops treating models as free as soon as the account is on a paid plan.

expect.label: Hugging Face
expect.description: Inference Providers router across many hosts.

billing.note: No free tier: usage is paid from purchased credits (PRO accounts get $2 a month).

expect.label: Kilo Gateway
expect.description: Gateway with free models, no key required.

billing.note: Only :free models (and kilo-auto/free) are free; everything else, including some models listed at price 0, is paid from credits. Without a key: 200 requests an hour per IP.

expect.label: LLM7
expect.description: Free OpenAI-compatible endpoint; a key raises the limits.

billing.note: Only the turbo-tier models are free; the rest are usage-based.

expect.label: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
expect.description: European hosting, anonymous access with low limits.

billing.note: Free only without a key (anonymous, 2 requests a minute per model). With an API key usage is billed in EUR to your Public Cloud project, including Whisper per second of audio.

expect.label: Pollinations
expect.description: Community-funded free text, image and embedding models.

billing.note: Free models spend free Quest Pollen; models marked paid_only need purchased pollen and are never free. Choose paid if the account holds paid pollen.

expect.label: AI Horde
expect.description: Crowdsourced volunteer workers. Slow, queued, free.

billing.note: Volunteer capacity; expect queueing. Anonymous use works; a free key gives priority from kudos.

expect.label: Kourier
expect.description: Flat-rate inference billed by simultaneous requests.

billing.note: Keys on the same Kourier account share the plan slots; extra keys do not add capacity.
billing.planNote: Paid concurrency slots with no token or request-volume allowance. Choose your plan and edit the concurrent limit for bonuses.

expect.label: Ollama (local)
expect.description: Models running on your own Ollama server.

billing.note: Free only for a server on this machine or your private network; a public host such as ollama.com may charge.

expect.label: LM Studio (local)
expect.description: Models served by LM Studio on your network.

billing.note: Free only for a server on this machine or your private network; a public host such as ollama.com may charge.

expect.label: Custom OpenAI-compatible
expect.description: Any endpoint that speaks /v1/chat/completions (vLLM, LiteLLM, TGI, proxies, …).

billing.note: Choose "free" only if this endpoint never charges you.

expect.label: Custom Anthropic-compatible
expect.description: Any endpoint that speaks the Anthropic Messages API.

billing.note: Choose "free" only if this endpoint never charges you.

expect.label: Mistral AI
expect.description: Mistral, Codestral and Magistral models.

billing.note: API use needs billing activation and is pay as you go; the free mode has no API access. Choose free only for an old Experiment workspace without a payment method.

expect.label: ModelScope
expect.description: Free API-Inference for open models (ModelScope account required).

billing.note: Free daily points (about 250 calls to mainstream models a day); needs an Alibaba Cloud account with real-name verification. Points cannot be bought, so nothing is charged.

expect.label: NeoRouter Local
expect.description: Models running on this server, managed by your admin.

billing.note: Runs on this server: requests cost nothing.

expect.label: Nous Research
expect.description: Hermes models via the Nous Portal inference API.

billing.note: Paid models draw from prepaid Portal credits; only :free models are free.

expect.label: NVIDIA NIM
expect.description: Hosted NIM endpoints on build.nvidia.com for developers.

billing.note: No-cost trial API for prototyping (about 40 requests a minute, not for production per the terms). No payment method can be attached, so it cannot be charged.

expect.label: Ollama Cloud
expect.description: Large open models hosted by Ollama.

billing.note: Only a few cloud models are covered by the free monthly usage; all others are pay-per-token. Keep the usage-credit balance at $0 with auto-reload off so nothing can be charged once the free usage is used up.
billing.planNote: Pro ($20) and Max ($100) include monthly usage credits ($60 and $300) for all cloud models; with "plan, then pay per use", bought credits are used afterwards.

expect.label: OpenRouter
expect.description: Aggregator for hundreds of models. Models ending in :free cost nothing.

billing.note: Paid models draw from your credits. :free models allow 20 requests a minute and 50 a day (1,000 a day once 10 USD of credits were bought); a negative balance blocks them too.

expect.label: OpenAI
expect.description: GPT and o-series models.

billing.note: Prepaid credits; no free models through the API.

expect.label: Anthropic
expect.description: Claude models via the native Messages API.

billing.note: Prepaid credits; no free tier.

expect.label: xAI
expect.description: Grok models.

billing.note: Prepaid credits; requests are refused once they run out (unless invoiced billing is on).

expect.label: DeepSeek
expect.description: DeepSeek chat and reasoner models.

billing.note: Prepaid top-up; no free models.

expect.label: Moonshot AI
expect.description: Kimi models.

billing.note: Prepaid; a 1 USD recharge activates the API.

expect.label: MiniMax
expect.description: MiniMax text models.

billing.note: Pay as you go from balance. M Plan subscription keys are separate (see MiniMax M Plan).

expect.label: Alibaba Model Studio
expect.description: Qwen models (international DashScope endpoint).

billing.note: New accounts get a one-time quota (about 1M tokens per model, 90 days). After that you are billed unless Free Quota Only is turned on per model in Model Studio.

expect.label: ChatGPT
expect.description: Your ChatGPT plan through the Codex sign-in.

billing.note: Device sign-in must first be enabled in the ChatGPT security settings (or by a workspace admin). Extra credits are bought separately. Signs in the way Codex, OpenClaw and OpenCode do. Meant for your own plan: Team, Business and Enterprise workspaces follow their admins' rules, and sharing one plan between people is against the terms.
billing.planNote: Uses your ChatGPT plan's Codex limits (a 5-hour window on most plans, plus weekly limits); ChatGPT reports them with each answer.

expect.label: Synthetic
expect.description: Open models on a flat subscription, for any OpenAI-compatible tool.

billing.note: Requests within the plan cost nothing extra; extra usage beyond it is billed at API prices if you allow it.
billing.planNote: Go 9 USD, Standard 30 USD, Big 90 USD a month. A weekly credit limit that refills 2% every 3.4 hours; NeoRouter reads what is left from Synthetic.

expect.label: MiniMax M Plan
expect.description: The MiniMax subscription (Go, Explore, Build) with its own plan key.

billing.note: The M Plan key works in any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible tool; usage from all tools counts against the same windows.
billing.planNote: Usage windows of 5 hours and a week; MiniMax reports what is left of each.

expect.label: Kimi Code
expect.description: The Kimi membership coding plan with its own API key.

billing.note: Kimi lists the tools it supports and forbids disguising the client; NeoRouter identifies itself honestly, so Kimi may refuse it. Check the membership terms before relying on it.
billing.planNote: Plus and higher: a rolling 5-hour limit plus the membership's monthly credit pool (older plans also have a weekly limit). The Go tier does not include Kimi Code.

expect.label: OpenCode Go
expect.description: The OpenCode Go subscription: open and partner models for coding agents, with monthly usage limits.

billing.note: Needs the Go subscription ($10 a month, Go Plus $40, Teams $20 a member). Some models (DeepSeek among them) need the workspace Privacy setting on Global regions. Muse Spark Contributor and Iceman Contributor train on your prompts, so they start switched off. Grok, GPT and Claude Haiku keep requests for 30 days; most others keep none.
billing.planNote: A monthly dollar limit per model, with a 5-hour window (20% of it) and a weekly one (50%). NeoRouter reads the three windows from the OpenCode usage endpoint. With Extra Usage on, OpenCode carries on from your balance.

expect.label: Pool partner
expect.description: Free capacity a pool partner shares with you.

billing.note: Runs on a partner’s free connections.

expect.label: Tavily
expect.description: Search built for AI agents, with page extracts.

billing.note: 1,000 free credits a month on the Researcher plan, no card needed (a basic search costs 1, an advanced one 2); requests stop at zero until the 1st. With pay-as-you-go turned on, searches beyond are billed at about 0.008 USD a credit.

expect.label: Exa
expect.description: Neural web search that returns page text.

billing.note: 10 USD of free credit every month, no card needed (about 1,400 to 2,500 searches; first team only). At zero, requests fail; a card is only charged if auto recharge is on.

expect.label: Linkup
expect.description: Web search API with sourced page content.

billing.note: 20 USD of free credit a month (about 4,000 standard searches) for accounts with a work email; requests fail when it runs out. Top-ups are manual.

expect.label: Parallel
expect.description: Search with excerpts ranked for LLMs.

billing.note: Up to 80 USD of credit once at sign-up. The 5 USD monthly credit needs a card on file, and use beyond it is billed to that card: choose free only for a key without a card.

expect.label: Firecrawl
expect.description: Search plus scraping into clean markdown.

billing.note: Free plan: 1,000 credits a month, no card (a search of 10 results costs 2, so about 500 searches), 10 searches a minute. Requests fail when credits run out.

expect.label: Serper
expect.description: Google results as JSON.

billing.note: 2,500 free queries once at sign-up, then prepaid credit packs: it never bills automatically. Paid credits expire after 6 months.

expect.label: Brave Search
expect.description: Independent web index.

billing.note: No free plan any more: a card is required. Every plan includes 5 USD of credit a month (about 1,000 searches, if Brave is credited on your site); searches beyond are billed at about 5 USD per 1,000.

expect.label: Jina Search
expect.description: Search that returns the pages as LLM-ready text.

billing.note: A new key comes with 10M free tokens, once (a search costs from 10,000). After that, prepaid top-ups; a saved card is only charged automatically if auto recharge is on.

expect.label: SearXNG
expect.description: Your own self-hosted metasearch instance (JSON output enabled).

billing.note: Self-hosted and free. The instance must allow format=json in its settings.

expect.label: SiliconFlow
expect.description: Open model hosting; new accounts get a small trial credit.

billing.note: Balance-based. New accounts get about 1 USD of trial credit; the international service has no permanently free models.

expect.label: SEA-LION
expect.description: AI Singapore’s Southeast Asian language models; a free trial key, 10 requests a minute.

billing.note: Free trial key, one per person; there is no billing.

expect.label: Typhoon
expect.description: Thai language models from SCB 10X; a free research API.

billing.note: Free research API; usage data is collected to improve the models.

expect.label: LongCat
expect.description: Meituan’s LongCat models; prepaid, no free tier.

billing.note: Prepaid balance or 30-day token packs; requests are refused at 0 USD.

expect.label: Electron Hub
expect.description: About 600 models on one key; models ending in :free cost nothing, about 10 a day.

billing.note: Models ending in :free use daily "Neutrinos", not money: 10 a day (reset 21:00 UTC), failed requests count too, and phone verification is needed. Other models use plan credits or a prepaid balance.

expect.label: Kenari
expect.description: Indonesian gateway priced in rupiah; models ending in :free cost nothing.

billing.note: Models ending in :free: 50 a day, 5 a minute (1,000 a day after a Rp 10.000 top-up). Others use a prepaid rupiah balance.

expect.label: BazaarLink
expect.description: Taiwanese gateway; models ending in :free cost nothing within a daily cap.

billing.note: Models ending in :free: 10 a minute, 60 a day (120 after a top-up). NeoRouter tells it to refuse past the cap instead of billing. Others use a prepaid balance.

expect.label: Reka
expect.description: Reka’s own models plus open models; prepaid.

billing.note: Prepaid credits, no free tier; requests fail at 0 USD.

expect.label: Baidu Qianfan
expect.description: Baidu’s ERNIE and hosted open models, billed in CNY.

billing.note: Billed in CNY after use, so the account can run into debt. No free models confirmed.

expect.label: Volcengine Ark
expect.description: ByteDance’s Doubao and hosted open models, billed in CNY.

billing.note: One-time free tokens per model at sign-up (safe-trial mode stops there). With that mode off, use is billed in CNY after the fact.

expect.label: iFlytek Spark
expect.description: iFlytek’s Spark models; Spark Lite is free.

billing.note: Spark Lite is free with daily caps; other models need bought quota. Each key works for one model only.

expect.label: B.AI
expect.description: Gateway to Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more; prepaid credits.

billing.note: Prepaid credits, no free models.

expect.label: AnyAPI
expect.description: Gateway with a small daily free allowance on its free models.

billing.note: Free plan without a card: free models only, about 100K tokens a day (the cap may be shared). On pay as you go, overage is charged automatically.

expect.label: AMD Radeon Cloud
expect.description: AMD’s free model API on its China site, with a daily cap.

billing.note: Free trial service with a daily points cap (reset 00:00 Beijing time); not for production and there is no way to pay.

expect.label: Agnes AI
expect.description: Agnes’ own models; the Flash models are free during a promotion.

billing.note: Flash text, image and video models are free for people without a plan during a limited-time promotion. Pro models are charged from plan or pack credits.

expect.label: Routeway
expect.description: About 280 models; models ending in :free cost nothing, 200 a day.

billing.note: Models ending in :free: 200 a day (reset 00:00 UTC), one at a time. Paid models need a positive balance.

expect.label: AINative Studio
expect.description: Developer platform with a model API on monthly credit plans.

billing.note: Paid plans from 5 USD a month (3-day trial) with monthly credits.

expect.label: Aion Labs
expect.description: Aion Labs’ roleplay and storytelling models with a small daily free allowance.

billing.note: Free tier without a card: about 20,000 tokens a day. Once you top up, credits are spent; switch to paid then.

expect.label: NavyAI
expect.description: One key for 130+ models on daily token plans; the free plan has 150K tokens a day.

billing.note: Free plan: 150K tokens a day, 20 requests a minute; each model uses tokens at its own multiplier. Premium models need a paid plan (from 10 USD a month).

expect.label: NaraRouter
expect.description: Indonesian gateway with a small free plan (one model) and day or week token passes.

billing.note: Free plan: one model, 7M tokens a day, 15 requests a minute, after Telegram verification or a 1 USD top-up. Everything else is prepaid credit or day/week passes.

expect.label: OrcaRouter
expect.description: Zero-markup gateway; models ending in -free cost nothing within tight daily caps.

billing.note: Models ending in -free never touch the wallet: about 10 requests a minute and 50 a day (more after 20 USD lifetime spend), with a small prompt cap; needs an established GitHub account linked. Others bill a prepaid wallet.

expect.label: UnoRouter
expect.description: 300+ models on one key; models ending in :free cost nothing, about one request a minute each.

billing.note: Models ending in :free never use your balance, about one request a minute each. Some need a one-time consent per provider at unorouter.com/consents and are refused if you objected to data use. All others bill a prepaid USD balance.

expect.label: xKiro
expect.description: 69 models on one key; about a third are free within a daily token allowance.

billing.note: Models marked free share 500K tokens a day (1M with Telegram verified). Paid models bill a prepaid wallet; images past the free allowance and web tools also charge it.

expect.label: OpenCode Console
expect.description: Pay-as-you-go access to coding models tested by OpenCode (formerly Zen).

billing.note: Prepaid credits with a 4.6% + 0.31 USD fee per purchase; auto-recharge can charge your card. Its free models only work inside OpenCode, so NeoRouter leaves them out. OpenAI and Anthropic models keep requests 30 days; most others keep nothing.

expect.label: Api.Airforce
expect.description: Cheap gateway to 790 models; the free plan is 1 request a minute on about 28 basic models.

billing.note: Free plan: models marked free, 1 request a minute, 1,000 a day. Topping up switches on pay as you go automatically; plans from 9.99 USD a month.

expect.label: APInex
expect.description: Crypto-funded gateway to 46 models; models starting with free/ use a daily free allowance.

billing.note: Models starting with free/ never touch the wallet and use a daily allowance metered by weight. Others bill a prepaid USD wallet topped up with crypto.

expect.label: BlazeAPI
expect.description: Discounted gateway to 150+ models; 18 free/ models with 450K tokens a day.

billing.note: Models starting with free/ are free: 450K tokens a day, 10 requests a minute, after email verification. Others bill a prepaid crypto balance (from 1 USD).

expect.label: BlockRun
expect.description: Pay-per-call API for 117 models, by card or USDC; nine open models are free.

billing.note: Nine open models are free (30 requests a minute and 300 an hour per IP). Others bill prepaid credit, or a monthly invoice on enterprise accounts.

expect.label: CLōD
expect.description: Low-cost inference for 50+ models; 100 free requests a day on 8 open models.

billing.note: 100 free requests a day on 8 open models (1,000 after a 25 USD purchase). Past that, even free models bill the wallet per token if it has money.

expect.label: DreamPrompting
expect.description: Free router over providers’ free tiers; every model is free within a daily quota.

billing.note: Every model is free: 5,000 requests and 500K tokens a day, 100 a minute. Pro is a flat 9 USD a month with no per-use charges.

expect.label: Experiential Labs
expect.description: One key for 959 models; the free plan covers three models with 1M tokens a day (card check needed).

billing.note: Free plan: GPT-6 Luna, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Clef share 1M tokens a day, 10 requests a minute, after a 1 USD card hold. With "Keep going on credits" on, use past that bills your balance; models ending in :free always stop instead.

expect.label: Gizmo Platforms
expect.description: Playground and API at provider cost plus a small fee; zero-cost models are free within a monthly quota.

billing.note: Free plan: 1 USD of usage a week and 1,000 free-model API calls a month, 20 a minute. Beyond that, provider cost plus 5% from a prepaid balance.

expect.label: Inferbase
expect.description: AI gateway with its own hosted models; the free plan covers cheap models within daily caps.

billing.note: Free plan without a card: 5,000 requests a month; hosted models up to 2 USD per million output tokens are free within 100 requests and 0.50 USD a day. Dearer models need credit and are refused without it, not charged.

expect.label: IteraCompute
expect.description: Open models (Qwen, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek) pay as you go, with one free Qwen model.

billing.note: Qwen3.8-27B is free (30M tokens a month, no card) until 24 November 2026; other models are charged from your balance.

expect.label: KiosAPI
expect.description: Indonesian AI gateway priced in rupiah, with five free models.

billing.note: Five models are free: 50 requests a day, 5 a minute, after email verification. Other models are charged in rupiah from a prepaid balance.

expect.label: LLMTR
expect.description: Turkish AI gateway with Turkey-hosted and global models, prepaid credit.

billing.note: Prepaid credit (top-ups carry an 8% margin). Models ending in -free cost nothing; their limits are not published.

expect.label: Logfare
expect.description: Free inference with fair-use limits; prompts are logged.

billing.note: Free, no card, no paid tier. All traffic is logged and may be used for evaluation; premium models need a training opt-in. New accounts have lower limits for their first day.

expect.label: Lucidity Composite
expect.description: Roleplay-oriented API proxy with a small daily free allowance.

billing.note: Models ending in :free share 80 requests a day; Synth has its own 80. Some free "contributor" models train on prompts. Others need credits (provider price + 25%) or a plan.

expect.label: Onomeo
expect.description: Pay-as-you-go API for major models (beta).

billing.note: Prepaid balance (from 5 USD). Free answers apply only to its web chat, not the API.

expect.label: PlugSky
expect.description: Its own routed models; two free models, the rest on monthly plans.

billing.note: Free plan without a card: plugsky-micro and plugsky-lite, 500 requests and 250K tokens a day (less for new accounts). Others need a plan (8 to 120 USD a month).

expect.label: Router9
expect.description: Image, video and chat models on a monthly credit plan.

billing.note: Which models the free plan covers is not published.
billing.planNote: Monthly credits: Free (about 1 USD), Pro 29 USD, Max 59 USD.

expect.label: Septor Labs
expect.description: Gateway to open and frontier models, with a 1 USD trial and capped free models.

billing.note: A one-time 1 USD trial credit (90 days) and free models capped at 50 requests and 500K tokens a day; free traffic goes through third-party aggregators. Plans from 20 USD a month.

expect.label: SimpleLLM
expect.description: EU-hosted open models, pay per token.

billing.note: Its terms could not be verified on the official site.

expect.label: Speka
expect.description: Gateway to open models with 1 USD of free usage a month.

billing.note: Free plan without a card: 1 USD of model usage a month, 10 requests a minute; requests are refused once it is spent. Paid plans (19 to 399 USD) bill overage.

expect.label: Waterfall
expect.description: Gateway that routes to free models first, then paid ones.

billing.note: Free without a card on models ending in -free (community rate limits). Paid models need card credits (from 10 USD, 4% markup) or x402; its auto route may use them when credit exists.

expect.label: Open-Meteo
expect.description: Open weather forecasts from national weather services. No key needed.

billing.note: Free without a key for non-commercial use: 600 calls a minute, 5,000 an hour, 10,000 a day, 300,000 a month. Commercial use needs a paid plan (a key and customer-api.open-meteo.com as the base URL). Data is CC BY 4.0: credit Open-Meteo.

expect.label: OpenWeatherMap
expect.description: Current weather and a 5-day forecast in 3-hour steps.

billing.note: Free plan: 60 calls a minute and 1,000,000 a month for current weather, the 5-day forecast and geocoding. A place name costs one extra geocoding call. Requests fail beyond the limits.

expect.label: WeatherAPI.com
expect.description: Current weather and forecasts by place name or coordinates.

billing.note: Free plan: 100,000 calls a month with a 3-day forecast. Beyond that no data until the next month: it never bills automatically.

expect.label: Tomorrow.io
expect.description: Hyperlocal forecasts with hourly and daily steps.

billing.note: Free plan: 500 calls a day, 25 an hour, 3 a second. Asking for current weather and a forecast uses two calls. Requests fail beyond the limits.

expect.label: Visual Crossing
expect.description: Timeline weather: current, hourly and 15-day forecasts in one call.

billing.note: Free plan: about 1,000 records a day (30,000 a month), commercial use allowed; one forecast for one place is one record. Paid use is the separate Metered plan: choose paid for such keys.

expect.label: Z.ai (GLM)
expect.description: GLM models from Zhipu, international endpoint. Flash models are free.

billing.note: Only GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash are free; newer Flash models such as GLM-5.3-Flash are paid.

expect.label: Zhipu BigModel
expect.description: GLM models from Zhipu, mainland China endpoint. Flash models are free.

billing.note: Only GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash are free; newer Flash models such as GLM-5.3-Flash are paid.
